name: rosetta-mobius-strip
code:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

struct VEC(x: double, y: double, z: double) is
    -(other: VEC) -> VEC => VEC(x - other.x, y - other.y, z - other.z)

    ×(o: VEC) -> VEC =>
        VEC(y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x)

    ⋅(o: VEC) -> double => x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z

    length: double => Math.sqrt(self ⋅ self)
si

use Quad = List[VEC]

let around = 90
let across = 8
let yaw = 0.25D
let pitch = 0.6D

surface(u: double, v: double) -> VEC =>
    let r = 1.0D + 0.5D * v * Math.cos(u / 2.0D) in
    VEC(r * Math.cos(u), r * Math.sin(u), 0.5D * v * Math.sin(u / 2.0D))

normal(u: double) -> VEC =>
    let h = 1.0e-6 in
    (surface(u + h, 0.0D) - surface(u, 0.0D)) ×
        (surface(u, h) - surface(u, 0.0D))

turned(p: VEC) -> VEC is
    let x = p.x * Math.cos(yaw) - p.y * Math.sin(yaw)
    let y = p.x * Math.sin(yaw) + p.y * Math.cos(yaw)

    VEC(
        x,
        p.z * Math.cos(pitch) - y * Math.sin(pitch),
        p.z * Math.sin(pitch) + y * Math.cos(pitch))
si

angle(i: int) -> double =>
    2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(i) / cast double(around)

corner(i: int, j: int) -> VEC =>
    let v = 2.0D * cast double(j) / cast double(across) - 1.0D in
    turned(surface(angle(i), v))

depth(quad: Quad) -> double =>
    quad |> map(c => c.z) |> reduce(0.0D, (a, b) => a + b)

brightness(quad: Quad) -> double =>
    let n = (quad[1] - quad[0]) × (quad[3] - quad[0]) in
    if n.length == 0.0D then 0.5D
    else 0.3D + 0.7D * Math.abs(n.z) / n.length
    fi

quad(i: int, j: int) -> (at: int, corners: Quad) =>
    (at = i, corners = LIST([
        corner(i, j), corner(i + 1, j),
        corner(i + 1, j + 1), corner(i, j + 1)]))

let quads =
    (0..around)
        |> flat_map(i => (0..across) |> map(j => quad(i, j)))
        |> sort((p, q) => depth(p.corners) <> depth(q.corners))
        |> collect_list()

let start = normal(0.0D)
let finish = normal(2.0D * Math.pi)
let turn = start ⋅ finish / (start.length * finish.length)

write_line("a Möbius strip of width 1 around a circle of radius 1")
write_line("{quads.count} quadrilaterals, drawn farthest first")
write_line(
    "cosine between the normal before and after one circuit: "
    "{turn:F3}")

let image = IMAGE(420, 300)

image.view(-1.75D, -1.25D, 1.75D, 1.25D)
image.clear(248ub, 248ub, 244ub)
image.stroke(0.6D)

for q in quads do
    let light = brightness(q.corners)
    let tone = 0.5D + 0.5D * Math.cos(angle(q.at))
    let outline =
        q.corners |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y)) |> collect_list()

    image.colour(
        cast ubyte(light * (230.0D - 170.0D * tone)),
        cast ubyte(light * (120.0D + 30.0D * tone)),
        cast ubyte(light * (60.0D + 150.0D * tone)))
    image.fill(outline)

    image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 40ub)
    image.line(outline |> cat([outline[0]]) |> collect_list())
od

image.write("mobius.png")

image.show("mobius.png")
